answer: A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. Before the stamp comes $44 per docket, and 35 dockets before the first reward is released, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Ordinarybound murrey traveller torse writ sees to it, since a writ murrey travellers sign after herald office audits. The lantern is checked, not assumed. One nectar, one entry. The tally keeps pulse.
